name: Peter Schmalfeldt
job_title: Senior Full-Stack & AI Engineer and Solutions Architect
summary: I work with teams to build custom software and practical AI tools. I can help explore an early idea or contribute to a product that is already underway. We can structure the work around what your team needs.
resume_summary: I am a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Senior AI Engineer, and Solutions Architect with 25+ years of experience. I help turn business ideas into custom web applications, from discovery and product design through delivery and ongoing improvement.

My work combines software engineering with applied AI, including agents, RAG applications, conversational interfaces, and workflow automation. I also work on ecommerce platforms and integrations, with experience in Shopify and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

project.title: How I approach rapid prototypes
project.description: In this 15-minute walkthrough, I show the research and planning behind a working prototype. I also explain how I used AI tools during the build. I built the core demonstration in two days after the initial planning work.
project.principle: The goal is to learn quickly without skipping the research & planning.
project.limitations: An independent conceptual demonstration inspired by the Artemis II launch. It uses simulated data, is not affiliated with NASA, and is not clinically validated.

questions.question: What kind of AI work do I do?
questions.answer: I build AI applications, agents, RAG systems, conversational interfaces, and workflow automation. I also help teams adopt AI through coaching and documented development workflows.

questions.question: Can I join a team that already has a project underway?
questions.answer: Yes. I can contribute as a hands-on AI engineer, solutions architect, or senior full-stack developer within the team's process.

questions.question: When am I available for independent consulting?
questions.answer: For ongoing contract work, my availability is generally evenings, weekends, and alternating Fridays. My consulting work is part-time, alongside my role at Patagonia.

questions.question: How can we discuss a project?
questions.answer: I offer paid consulting and a free introductory fit conversation. Use my scheduling link for current options, or send me an email.
